title: Home Office & Ergonomics Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=stretchly:break) OR (index=personal sourcetype=pomofocus:session)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="stretchly:break","primary",sourcetype="pomofocus:session","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from stretchly:break and pomofocus:session to see whether two home office feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `stretchly:break` and `pomofocus:session` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main home office data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
